title: Open panel navigates to Desktop with Command-D and cancels
note: macOS 26's Open panel is a standalone window that the recorder's dialog heuristic does not report, so dialog.present is ignored while it is open; cancelled.dialog.present must still be false and ⌘D must select Desktop. The chooser's Desktop favourite mirrors Files' own sidebar visibility setting (crates/finder/src/places.rs sidebar_visibility, default show_desktop=false), and the Mac recording was made with Desktop checked in Finder's sidebar, so `setup.state` seeds that one setting; without it the Desktop row never exists in a fresh sandbox and ⌘D has nothing to select regardless of timing.
